title: How long is the honeybee in all?
description: Three body parts of a honeybee are added by adding the units, then the tenths, and then moving ten tenths into a unit. Keeko doubts the total and forgets the extra unit made by the tenths.
teaching_notes: One idea: when the tenths add to ten or more, ten of them move over to the units. Watch for students who keep the tenths separate and leave out the extra unit.

source: The parts of a honeybee are 2 3/10 units (head), 5 4/10 units (thorax) and 7 5/10 units (abdomen). Find its total length.
video_script.why: The child has added two lengths with units and tenths and now adds three, where the tenths pass ten.
video_script.substitution: Add the units, add the tenths, then move each group of ten tenths into the units.
video_script.anchor: A honeybee drawn in three parts, head, thorax and abdomen, laid end to end along a unit scale
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko adds the units to get 14 and keeps the 2 tenths of 12 tenths, forgetting that 10 tenths make one more unit, so the total is wrongly 14 2/10.
video_script.payoff_line: The total length is fifteen and two tenths units
maths_rules: 14 + 1 = 15 units, and 2/10 more, which is 15 2/10 units.
Slip: keeping 14 units and 2 tenths forgets the unit made by 10 tenths.
video_script.design: One idea: ten tenths move over to become one more unit. Assumes the child has added two lengths of units and tenths. Wrong idea: leave out the extra unit made by the tenths. The honeybee stays all video; the working band builds in the idea part.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; a honeybee drawn in three labelled parts, head 2 3/10 units, thorax 5 4/10 units, abdomen 7 5/10 units, laid end to end along a unit scale

marks.book: the title card arrives: From your book
marks.head: the head appears on the scale, 2 3/10 units long
marks.rest: the thorax and the abdomen appear after it, 5 4/10 units and 7 5/10 units long
marks.ask: a bracket over all three parts glows

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='head'/>The head of a honeybee is two and three tenths units long.
<bookmark mark='rest'/>The thorax is five and four tenths units, and the abdomen is seven and five tenths units.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>What is the total length of the honeybee?

beats.on_screen: the honeybee stays on the board; Keeko sits at the corner of the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: a unit bar cut into 10 parts labelled 1/10; the 10 parts glow together as 1 unit

marks.small: the unit bar is cut into 10 parts, each labelled 1/10
marks.ten: the 10 parts glow together as 1 unit

narration: <bookmark mark='small'/>Tenths are small parts of a unit.
<bookmark mark='ten'/>When ten of them gather together, they make one whole unit.

beats.on_screen: Given: head = 2 3/10 units, thorax = 5 4/10 units, abdomen = 7 5/10 units

marks.given: the three lengths are written in a column

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the head is two and three tenths units. The thorax is five and four tenths units. The abdomen is seven and five tenths units.

beats.on_screen: To find: the total length of the honeybee

marks.find: the words total length are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the total length of the honeybee.

marks.one: the whole units 2, 5 and 7 are circled and 2 + 5 + 7 = 14 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Step one, add the whole units. Two, five and seven make fourteen units.

marks.two: the tenths 3/10, 4/10 and 5/10 are circled and 3/10 + 4/10 + 5/10 = 12/10 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='two'/>Step two, add the tenths. Three tenths, four tenths and five tenths make twelve tenths.

marks.three: 12/10 splits into 10/10 and 2/10 and 10/10 turns into 1 unit

narration: <bookmark mark='three'/>Step three, twelve tenths is ten tenths and two tenths. Ten tenths make one unit, so we get one unit and two tenths.

marks.four: the extra 1 unit joins the 14 units to make 15 units, with 2/10 left

narration: <bookmark mark='four'/>Step four, add the extra unit to the fourteen units. That makes fifteen units, with two tenths left.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>The total length is fifteen and two tenths units.
The honeybee is a little more than fifteen units long.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows 14 and 2/10; below it 12/10 splits into 10/10 and 2/10 with the 10/10 glowing as 1 unit; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

marks.fix: the bubble is struck through and the 10/10 glows and moves to the units

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the total is fourteen and two tenths. Keeko adds the units and keeps the two tenths.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>But twelve tenths is more than one whole unit. Ten of the twelve tenths make one more unit, so the total is one unit longer.
